_readme: Copy to appsettings.Worker.Production.json, replace every <...> value, and pass it to Install-WorkbenchWorker.ps1 -SettingsFile. No secrets: Graph and Power Platform use the worker certificate selected by subject, SQL uses Windows authentication as the worker gMSA. The ITSM credential is never stored here (see Deploy-Production.md, step 9).

Worker.ClientId: <Worker app registration client ID for this environment>

Notifications.TeamsAppId: <Teams app ID from the org catalog>
Notifications.ChannelFlowUrl: <Power Automate HTTP trigger URL, or empty until the flow exists>
